spellbook.finance/limitations: This marks all live units in the named intake entry. It does not record receipt or physical opening.
Holding does not remove an existing marketplace listing. Use spellbook_sealed_listing_pause to remove a SpellBook-managed ManaPool offer.
Releasing a hold can make sealed stock eligible for future publication. It does not publish by itself.

description: Mark every still-sealed unit in one purchase entry as a long-term hold, or release that hold. A hold keeps physical inventory and market value but excludes those units from sealed listing. Read spellbook_sealed_portfolio before and after to check heldQuantity.

entryId.description: The exact purchase entryId from spellbook_sealed_portfolio, including the SEALED# prefix when present. Required.

hold.description: True excludes live units from listing; false makes them eligible again. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the entry. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_portfolio_hold_set
